prompt.project_info: Create a refined indoor satin portrait of an approved adult woman seated on a beige upholstered chair.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy medium-brown hair, a soft smile, natural glamour makeup, and small silver drop earrings with a delicate silver chain. She sits slightly angled with one hand touching her hair and wears a champagne-light-gold satin slip dress with a cowl neckline and spaghetti straps.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait from the knees up, seated on a beige upholstered chair, cream curtains to one side, dark window behind, direct eye contact, hand near hair, and satin drape as the visual focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft direct frontal light with controlled highlights on the skin and satin, gentle shadows, quiet elegant indoor atmosphere, and natural color.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait, natural perspective, sharp face and fabric, realistic satin folds and skin texture, medium depth of field, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a refined photorealistic 4K indoor portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy medium-brown hair, a soft smile, natural glamour makeup, small silver drop earrings, and a delicate silver chain. She sits slightly angled on a beige upholstered chair, one hand raised to touch her hair, looking directly at the camera. She wears a champagne-light-gold satin slip dress with a cowl neckline and spaghetti straps. Frame her from the knees up with cream curtains and a dark window behind. Use soft direct frontal light, controlled highlights on natural skin and satin fabric, realistic folds, sharp facial detail, natural color, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
